# jans_client_authorization (Data Source)

Data source for retrieving the OAuth client authorizations granted by a user.

This maps to the config-api read-only endpoint that returns, for the given user, every
client the user has authorized together with the scopes granted to that client.

## OAuth Scopes Required

- `https://jans.io/oauth/client/authorizations.readonly`



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) Identifier of the user whose client authorizations are retrieved.

### Read-Only

- `authorizations` (List of Object) List of clients authorized by the user and the scopes granted to each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authorizations))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authorizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authorizations`

Read-Only:

- `client` (String)
- `scopes` (List of String)
